in_marathi.name: Sajili
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wisdom, Learning, Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sajili हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sajili is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sajjili' which means 'wisdom', 'learning' or 'knowledge'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu culture, representing the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. The name is also associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning.
